description: Welcome! I’m Aimee Kotek Wilson, and I’ve been Tina’s partner for more than 20 years – we got married in 2016 after marriage equality was finally legalized. It was a shared passion for helping Oregonians that first brought us together. A dedication to creating community and opportunity for everyone has always been the foundation of […]
